tech.name: Taser
tech.description: An electroshock weapon that fires two darts on wires, delivering a current that briefly disables the target. Cover, a physicist who had worked in aerospace and on NASA's Apollo program, named it after the novel: TASER stands for "Thomas A. Swift's Electric Rifle." The original model used gunpowder to fire its darts, so the US government classified it as a firearm.
